title: ChatGPT-supported Python programming activities
summary: First-year students complete programming exercises, concept-mastery work, and problem-solving activities during an eight-week Python course. Students may use a GPT-4 web interface without restriction, and the course records their dialogues and code submissions.

sources.title: Enhancing Programming Education with ChatGPT: A Case Study on Student Perceptions and Interactions in a Python Course
sources.evidence_quote: The course has three different learning activities focused on programming exercises, concept mastery, and problem-solving. Students are allowed to use ChatGPT freely to complete these activities.
